title: 0.3 Shutdown + lifecycle crash hardening
description: Establish reliable shutdown guards to prevent crashes during plugin unload.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Single "app closing/unloading" guard checked by providers, tasks, timers, and async callbacks
- [ ] Polling stops before teardown
- [ ] Tasks cancelled before teardown
- [ ] Signals/timers disconnected before teardown
- [ ] Delayed callbacks/cache rebuilds/renderer mutations prevented during shutdown
notes:
ANALYSIS COMPLETED:

The shutdown/lifecycle architecture is already comprehensive:

EXISTING GUARDS:
- _is_unloading - set immediately in unload()
- _app_is_quitting - set by aboutToQuit signal  
- _skip_layer_ops - prevents layer mutations during shutdown
- TaskManager._shutting_down flag
- ProviderController shutdown flag (BUG-030)
- LayerManager._application_closing flag

TEARDOWN ORDER (already correct):
1. Set flags FIRST
2. Stop coordinate timer early
3. Set layer_manager closing flag
4. Lifecycle cleanup (signals, components)
5. Cancel tasks via TaskManager
6. Remove UI elements

CHANGES MADE:
Added shutdown guards to 6 drawing tool callbacks that were missing them:
- _on_line_complete
- _on_range_rings_complete
- _on_bearing_complete
- _on_polygon_complete
- _on_drawing_cancelled
- _on_measurement_complete

Also added null checks for tool_registry before calling deactivate_current().
close_reason: Verified comprehensive shutdown guards already in place. Added guards to 6 drawing callbacks that were missing them.
